description: Black "Q PROOF" graphic (filename Qproof92) pairing Q drop #2173 (Sep 15 2018) with a White House "Statement from the Press Secretary" dated September 17, 2018 announcing declassification of Carter Page FISA materials and release of Russia-investigation text messages. The layout presents the drop's "DECLAS coming? MORE INCRIMINATING [TEXT] RELEASES COMING?" lines as predicting the statement; highlighted phrases mark the claimed correspondence. Bottom caption reads "PROOFS ARE IMPORTANT — Q".
text: Q PROOF:. Q !!mG7VJxZNCI No.235. Sep 15 2018 14:28:09 (EST). 2173. SEPT —-17—— [week of]. https://www.cnn.com/2018/09/15/politics/fema-presidential-alert-trump-emergency-test/index.html. DECLAS coming?. MORE INCRIMINATING [TEXT] RELEASES COMING?. DARK TO LIGHT. CARPET BOMBS >>> MOAB. Q. STATEMENTS & RELEASES. Statement from the Press Secretary. LAW & JUSTICE. Issued on: September 17, 2018. At the request of a number of committees of Congress, and for reasons of transparency, the President has directed the Office of the Director of National Intelligence and the Department of Justice (including the FBI) to provide for the immediate declassification of the following materials: (1) pages 10-12 and 17-34 of the June 2017 application to the FISA court in the matter of Carter W. Page; (2) all FBI reports of interviews with Bruce G. Ohr prepared in connection with the Russia investigation; and (3) all FBI reports of interviews prepared in connection with all Carter Page FISA applications. In addition, President Donald J. Trump has directed the Department of Justice (including the FBI) to publicly release all text messages relating to the Russia investigation, without redaction, of James Comey, Andrew McCabe, Peter Strzok, Lisa Page, and Bruce Ohr. PROOFS ARE IMPORTANT — Q
orgs: Office of the Director of National Intelligence
flags: The 'proof' framing — that the Q drop predicted the White House statement — is the graphic's claim, not an established fact

description: Photograph of demonstrators in yellow high-visibility vests at an outdoor street march holding a large black QAnon banner with a metallic letter Q over a tornado image. The banner reads "SHEEP NO MORE", "DARK TO LIGHT", carries a sticker-style graphic "NOS = FAKE NEWS", and a Dutch tagline meaning "The world is about to change", indicating a Dutch yellow-vest protest (NOS is the Dutch public broadcaster). Flags and a megaphone are visible in the crowd behind the banner.
text: SHEEP NO MORE. Q. DARK TO LIGHT. NOS = FAKE NEWS. De wereld staat op het punt te veranderen.
flags: Location inferred as the Netherlands from the Dutch-language banner and NOS reference; exact city/date not shown
Demonstrators are private individuals and are not identified

description: Press photograph of Huma Abedin and John Podesta walking together on a city sidewalk past a stone building. Abedin wears a black coat with a multicolored patterned scarf and shoulder bag; Podesta wears a navy suit with a blue shirt and tie. Watermark credits the image to Paul Martinka / Splash News.

Data table titled "Sealed Cases Filed: 11/30/2017 through 2/28/2019", the crowd-sourced "sealed indictments" count circulated in QAnon research circles. It lists every U.S. federal district (plus DC, territories) with monthly-period counts of new sealed court proceedings from 10/30/2017 through 2/28/2019 and a count-to-date per district, credited to a named Twitter research team and sourced to PACER.GOV. A yellow box totals 82,324 filings; footnotes caution the numbers include search warrants and other sealed proceedings, not only indictments.
text: Sealed Cases Filed: 11/30/2017 through 2/28/2019. From the Research Team of: @Avery1776, @emarie1225, @KathyMicale, @Livid2Point0 (formerly @Avonsalez), @MaurizioScrofa1 (formerly @Mscipio_African), @Tspinnerchaser & @vstil. State, District. Abbrev. 10/30/2017 - 10/31/2018. 11/1/2018 - 11/30/2018. 12/1/2018 - 12/30/2018. 12/31/2018 - 1/31/2019. 2/1/2019 - 2/28/2019. COUNT TO DATE. [Table of counts for every U.S. federal district, Alaska through Wyoming, incl. DC, Guam, Puerto Rico, Virgin Islands, Northern Mariana Islands; Georgia, Northern marked 'No online data available'; examples of COUNT TO DATE: California, Central 7,290. Massachusetts 2,834. Maryland 2,469. New York, Southern 2,854. Ohio, Southern 2,510. Pennsylvania, Eastern 2,188. Pennsylvania, Western 2,510. Texas, Western 3,037.] TOTALS 61,228. 5,233. 4,425. 5,606. 5,832. 82,324. TOTAL FILED FROM 10/30/2017 TO 2/28/2019 = 82,324. * Back-up files at: https://tinyurl.com/yabcbz2r. *Source = PACER.GOV. *The numbers represent NEW sealed court proceedings filed in the U.S. Federal District Criminal Courts during the periods listed and include criminal charges. Older counts may include search warrants - we have since discontinued counting items clearly labeled search warrants in our numbers. Some of these cases have since date of publish been unsealed or in limited circumstances, removed. *Additional contributions by: @Arazel50, @buildthewall_20, @damartin32, @LemboPhil, @t193931 and @TanHaley
flags: The 'sealed indictments' interpretation of these counts is the research team's claim; the table's own footnote concedes the counts include search warrants and other sealed proceedings, and independent analyses have disputed equating them with indictments
